name: DuckDB warehouse
role: Medallion warehouse (bronze/silver/gold/governance schemas); system of record for analytics
meaning: The embedded analytics database holding every Bronze, Silver, Gold and governance table
impact: Its 16 tables become Unity Catalog Delta tables; it is the core of wave 1
risk: It is a single file persisted in a CI cache; the real history may be incomplete

recommendation.reason: every transform and API route reads or writes it

name: SQLite event bus
role: Default local event log (topics, offsets) when Kafka is not configured

evidence.excerpt: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (

meaning: A local file that stands in for Kafka: it keeps every order, click and payment message
impact: Not migrated as a store; its topics map to the target ingestion design
risk: It keeps full PII payloads forever; if it is the live bus, history lives only here

recommendation.reason: default backend in config and fallback in CI and API

name: Kafka (Aiven)
role: Hosted event bus for orders, clicks, payments, fraud alerts and erasure requests (SASL_SSL/SCRAM)
meaning: The hosted Kafka service the scheduled pipeline publishes events to; host is kept in a CI secret
impact: Source for streaming ingestion on Databricks (Structured Streaming / Lakeflow)
risk: Host, region and retention are unknown; topic payloads carry clear-text PII

recommendation.reason: named in CI secrets and docs; host not in code (OQ-06)

name: Turso (libSQL) cloud database
role: Cloud mirror of all medallion and governance tables, dual-written and bulk-synced
meaning: A third-party cloud copy of the warehouse, including raw Bronze PII
impact: Likely retired once Unity Catalog serves the same tables; erasure must reach it until then
risk: If retired late, PII stays in a non-EU-proven third party

recommendation.reason: dual-write and sync code plus CI secrets name it

name: Hugging Face dataset swadhinbiswas/eustream
role: Published Parquet lake of Silver/Gold; also read back as a fallback seed
meaning: A public dataset hub where the pseudonymised customer and order tables are published
impact: Becomes a governed export (Delta Sharing or volume) or is retired
risk: Versioned history keeps erased customers; public visibility is unconfirmed

recommendation.reason: CI pushes to it every 4 h and the API reads it

name: Local Parquet lake
role: Parquet snapshots of Silver and Gold written by export_lake
meaning: Files on the runner or server that are the staging copy for the public dataset
impact: Replaced by Delta tables; nothing to migrate beyond the tables themselves
risk: Low on its own; it is the path by which PII reaches Hugging Face

recommendation.reason: written by export_lake and uploaded by CI

name: Local JSONL logs and state files
role: Erasure audit, metrics, pipeline and lineage logs; fraud scorer checkpoint
meaning: Plain files holding the audit trail of erasures and the run logs
impact: The audit trail must move to a governed table with retention; logs go to system tables
risk: Audit evidence lost or kept unbounded with customer ids

recommendation.reason: config defaults and writers in erasure.py and cli.py

name: Databricks DEV workspace
role: Target-side DEV: bundle eurostream-free deployed with 3 Lakeflow pipelines and 4 jobs into catalog eurostream
meaning: The Databricks workspace where a first port of the platform already runs (AWS us-east-2)
impact: The migration starts from this partial port, not from zero; its code must be recovered
risk: Its source was removed from the repo (c78138d); the port may diverge from the code read here

recommendation.reason: pipelines and jobs read live as the assessment service principal

name: AWS eu-central-1 (Terraform design)
role: Designed S3 lake bucket and MSK cluster; no evidence it is deployed
meaning: An AWS landing zone written in Terraform for a lake bucket and managed Kafka in Frankfurt
impact: Candidate target storage for Unity Catalog external locations if deployed
risk: May not exist: subnets default to empty and no state backend is configured

recommendation.reason: design only; ask whether it was ever applied (OQ-07)

name: Render web service eurostream-api
role: Hosts the FastAPI dashboard and governance API publicly
meaning: The public web host that serves the dashboard and erasure endpoints
impact: Consumers here are re-pointed to Databricks SQL or replaced by a Databricks App
risk: It is public with no auth on erasure endpoints

recommendation.reason: render.yaml blueprint with region and env

name: Hugging Face Space swadhinbiswas/eurostream
role: Second public deployment of the API/dashboard container
meaning: A second public copy of the dashboard and API, deployed on every push
impact: Retire or replace with the Databricks App; it must not keep serving old data
risk: Duplicate serving surface outside EU control

recommendation.reason: deploy workflow uploads the repo to it
